alt.en: The choir of a Gothic cathedral seen straight down its centre aisle. Tall rows of dark carved wooden stalls with spiky pinnacled canopies line both sides, brass lamps with shades glow on the desks, a gilded chandelier hangs from the panelled wooden roof, and at the far end a stained glass window rises above the high altar.
alt.es: El coro de una catedral gótica visto de frente a lo largo de su pasillo central. A ambos lados se alzan filas de sillería de madera oscura tallada, con doseles de pináculos puntiagudos; en los atriles brillan lámparas de latón con pantalla, del techo de madera artesonado cuelga una araña dorada y al fondo una vidriera se eleva sobre el altar mayor.

caption.en: The choir of Manchester Cathedral, the Collegiate Church of John Byrom's day, photographed in 2016. John Wainwright, who made the tune, was a singing man of this church when, at Christmas 1750, he and its singing men and boys sang Christians, Awake at Byrom's house.
caption.es: El coro de la catedral de Manchester, la Colegiata de los tiempos de John Byrom, fotografiado en 2016. John Wainwright, autor de la melodía, era cantor de esta iglesia cuando, en la Navidad de 1750, él y sus cantores y niños de coro cantaron Christians, Awake en casa de Byrom.

source: Michael D Beckwith, Manchester Cathedral Choir, photograph (HDR), inside the choir of Manchester Cathedral looking east to the high altar, 17 June 2016
